concept: Aurora Global Database: cross-Region DR with RPO < 1 s and RTO ~1 min
tests: Choosing a cross-Region DR mechanism for Aurora with very low RPO/RTO.
expected: Aurora Global Database — storage-based replication with lag typically <1 s; the secondary Region is promoted in about a minute. Triggers: "another AWS region", "RPO under a second", "RTO about a minute".
why_not: Manual cross-Region read replicas — more lag and management; snapshot copies — RPO in hours; Multi-AZ — only within a single Region.
